name: local-ssh-deploy
description: Save and recall reusable SSH server connection metadata so Codex can use the current system's native remote tools.

interface.shortDescription: Save SSH connections for Codex to use with native tools.
interface.longDescription: Opens a local connection editor with a native private-key path picker and saves named SSH connection metadata in permission-restricted user files. Inventory returns names only. For actual server work, Codex receives a hashed SSH alias and dedicated config path while OpenSSH reads the real host, username, port, and identity-file path directly. Raw connection fields, commands, passwords, and private key contents are not returned to the model.
defaultPrompt: Add a remote server connection and open its secure editor.
Check disk usage on my saved production server.
List my saved SSH server connections.
